name: Iozera / Eureka Park Tetouan AI Data Center
notes: Iozera announced an MoU with Morocco for a 386MW hyperscale AI data center and AI hub in Tetouan; DCD noted scarce details, so status is planned rather than construction/operational.

name: Cires Technologies TMED Data Center
notes: Tanger Med technology branch Cires provides cloud/digital services; Data Center Map lists a Tier 3 Tanger-Med Port facility with 600kVA transformer, 550kVA generator, and rack colocation services.

name: INWI Oujda Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists data-center services in Oujda/Oriental. A project CV describes a completed INWI Oujda data center with 300kW IT load and 450kW cooling; treated as weak but plausible evidence.

name: HosToWeb Fez Data Center
notes: HosToWeb states it runs its own Morocco data center for dedicated hosting and colocation; Data Center Map places the facility in Fez city center.

name: INWI Rabat Technopolis DC2
notes: Inwi opened a Rabat Technopolis data center offering 1,000 sqm with expansion potential; NOVEC describes the Rabat Technopolis build; Uptime lists Tier III design and constructed-facility certification.

name: Maroc Data Center / 3MDC Rabat Facility
notes: Data Center Map reports Maroc Datacenter/3MDC has a 2,000 sqm Rabat facility; Moroccan ministry page describes the Maroc Datacenter cloud platform and an International Gateway Data Center investment plan.

name: Orange Tech / Casablanca DC5
notes: Orange opened a new 1.5MW Casablanca/Nouaceur data center with more than 1,000 solar panels; trade sources call it Uptime-certified and focused on cloud, cybersecurity, and AI workloads.

name: Orange Maroc Casablanca Datacenter #1 / ETIX DC2
notes: Uptime lists Orange Maroc's Casablanca Datacenter #1 in Nouaceur; DCD says Orange acquired EtixEverywhere Maroc's 1MW Nouaceur DC2 facility in 2021.

name: N+ONE DATACENTER I, Phase 2 / Nouaceur campus
notes: Uptime lists N+ONE Datacenter I Phase 2 in Nouaceur; 2024 expansion reporting described an additional 2,000 sqm Nouaceur facility expected to be operational in 2024.

name: N+ONE DATACENTER II, Phase 1 / Settat campus
notes: Uptime lists N+ONE Datacenter II Phase 1 in Settat with Tier III certifications; N+ONE describes its Settat campus, and DCD reports N+ONE operates Morocco buildings split between Nouaceur and Settat.

name: Oracle Cloud Region Morocco West (Casablanca) hosted by N+ONE
notes: Oracle release notes say Morocco West (Casablanca), region identifier af-casablanca-1, became available on 2026-02-20; DCD reports N+ONE hosts the region.

name: INWI Settat Datacenter
notes: Inwi announced Tier 3 data center footprint expansion with new Settat and Marrakech sites; Uptime lists Inwi Settat Datacenter with Tier III design and constructed-facility certification.

name: INWI Marrakech Datacenter
notes: Inwi announced a new Tier 3 Marrakech site; Uptime lists Tier III design and constructed-facility certification. Capacity comes from a project profile describing 1,520kW IT load, so treat MW figure as lower-confidence.

name: Benguerir Data Center / African Supercomputing Center
developer: OCP Group / Mohammed VI Polytechnic University / Atlas Cloud Services
notes: UM6P/OCP inaugurated the Benguerir data center hosting the Toubkal supercomputer. DCD reports the facility can support up to 5MW IT load and is home to Atlas Cloud Services.

name: inwi Agadir Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists one Wana Corporate/inwi data center in Agadir, Souss-Massa. Inwi's own data-center service page confirms the operator offers Tier 3 hosting but does not enumerate Agadir on the captured page.
